entries.description: Built cnb-ledger-set.js (buildDefs/resolve/isBetweenNoteAndStaff/render) with 28 unit tests covering the architecture plan exhaustive cases (C, D, E, F, C-prime under 4-8 and 3-6-9, C-double-prime, A-sharp, octave awareness, proximity mode); rewrote test-ledger.html as display-rule-driven page with 4-8, 3-6-9, and proximity cards
Built cnb-double-notehead.js (pure layout() plus render()) with 6 unit tests: semiToY positioning, symmetric offsetPercent collision offset scaled by max notehead width, per-shape scale factors
Built cnb-card.js (Module 9: octave chord card composing grid, ledger set, double notehead, stem, labels) with 18 unit tests incl. render() DOM-stub coverage; test-card.html visual page

Built cnb-collection.js (Module 10: card collection with continuous background staff SVG, duration rows) with 9 unit tests; test-collection.html full chromatic row page; all 208 CNB + 240 legacy tests pass
